name: v4-lean-q
idea_origin: Leah's stat-perception line, experiment 09: v4-lean plus planning the quarter after a single observe (Energy and main-action choice numbers are the same every quarter in our runs; Formato found planning the quarter at once loses nothing in the replica)
hypothesis: Each observe adds ~650 tokens to an uncompressed history and each call resends the whole context. Planning the quarter after one observe removes about 2 calls per quarter; in the token model that cuts ~15% of tokens per game without depending on how much the model writes.
predicted_behaviour: Same quarterly actions as v4-lean; about 32 fewer calls per game; tokens per month about 15% below v4-lean in official games; no rejected actions beyond an occasional observe after a failed call.
refutation: Rejected or wrong quarterly actions, or no drop in tokens per month against v4-lean in official games.
